summary: purestorage.flashblade purefb_fs deprecates nfs_rules in favor of export_policy, removed in 2.0.0.

answer_card.title: purefb_fs nfs_rules deprecated
answer_card.answer_md: In `purefb_fs`, the `nfs_rules` parameter is deprecated in favor of **`export_policy`** and will be removed in 2.0.0. A deprecation notice is shown when it is used.
